purpose: Paired extraction research; no live promotion or expected-rate tuning
fixture: RGB-level signals, not encoded video or MediaPipe tracking
scoring: Consult injected rate only after estimation; report all-case coverage, accepted-set error, maximum error, errors over 5 BPM and abstentions, separately for development and held-out seeds
natural_video_policy: Same archived RGB, support and masks; report candidates and abstentions without per-window accuracy scores or choosing a winner from a usual/manual average BPM
limitations: Fixed synthetic conditions do not validate natural camera accuracy; saved sessions are development observations
